nodes.subtreeText: terraform test cleanup : The experimental test cleanup command. In experimental builds of Terraform, a manifest file and state files for each failed cleanup operation during test operations are saved within the .terraform local directory. The test cleanup command will attempt to clean up the local state files left behind automatically, without requiring manual intervention.
